kebab_example: aliyun cr update-chart-namespace --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --namespace-name test --auto-create-repo true --default-repo-type PUBLIC --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateChartNamespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace to which the repository belongs
parameters.help_zh: 镜像仓库命名空间名称
parameters.name: namespace_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create repositories in the namespace. Valid values:

*   `true`: automatically creates repositories in the namespace.
*   `false`: does not automatically create repositories in the namespace
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动创建仓库，取值：
- `true`：自动创建仓库
- `false`：不自动创建仓库
parameters.name: auto_create_repo

parameters.help_en:
The default type of the repository. Valid values:

*   `PUBLIC`: a public repository
*   `PRIVATE`: a private repository
parameters.help_zh:
默认仓库类型，取值：

- `PUBLIC`：公开仓库

- `PRIVATE`：私有仓库
parameters.name: default_repo_type
